user_message: What do you need from me to register?

argument.message: To register as a new patient, I'll need your first name, last name, date of birth, phone number, email address, and insurance provider with member ID (or 'self-pay'). For the demo, please use a phone number between 555-0100 and 555-0199 and an email ending with @example.com. Let me know what you have ready!
